Title: QudLink - Second Screen Companion
Description:
[h1]QudLink[/h1]
Turns a second screen into a Qud-styled control panel. Made for dual-screen handhelds like the AYN Thor, with Qud on the top screen and the QudLink app on the bottom one.

[h2][b]You need the companion app[/b][/h2]
This mod is only the game side. The interface is an Android app:
[b][url=https://github.com/UncookedNoodle/QudLink/releases/latest]Download QudLink.apk[/url][/b]
Install it on the same device that runs Qud, load a save, then open the app.
[b]No Android device?[/b] Open [b]http://127.0.0.1:8765/[/b] in a browser on the PC running Qud for the same interface.

[h2]What it does[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Act[/b] - abilities with live cooldowns and toggles, pinnable quick slots, common commands.
[*][b]Items[/b] - ground items nearby, equipment and inventory with real tiles; tap for actions (eat, equip, get...).
[*][b]Near[/b] - creatures in sight with HP, plus a movement pad.
[*][b]Char[/b] - attributes, mutations, skills, effects and a low-HP alert.
[*][b]Quest[/b] and [b]Log[/b] tabs.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The mod listens on 127.0.0.1:8765 only, so it can't be reached from your network.
[*]Commands wait while Qud has a menu or popup open.
[*]Source: [url=https://github.com/UncookedNoodle/QudLink]github.com/UncookedNoodle/QudLink[/url]
[/list]
